purpose: Frozen visual baseline environment. Approved at R0; visual baselines become gates only when captured under exactly these pinned parameters.
runner: TBD at R0 (Playwright screenshots or WebdriverIO screenshots); approved by R0 ADR before any baseline is frozen
osImage: stock OS desktop wallpaper and accent color; no third-party theming installed on the reference machine
webView: stock system WebView build (WKWebView / WebView2 / WebKitGTK 4.1); no user zoom or text-scaling overrides
fonts: system font stack only: -apple-system/SF Pro (macOS), Segoe UI (Windows), Ubuntu/DejaVu (Linux); no custom @font-face, no font smoothing differences across runs
theme: both light and dark; theme selected before launch and kept constant for the entire run
viewport: fixed window 1280x800, devicePixelRatio 1.0, no device emulation
animationState: reduced motion enabled; CSS animations disabled for determinism
changedPixelRatio: >= 0.1% of viewport pixels changed triggers a diff review; < 0.1% is accepted noise
masks: reviewed masks per state: text caret, animated spinner, remote image areas, dynamic time displays; every mask carries a written justification
